method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: American Express is a New York-headquartered global payments and card company. Strategy roles here are in-house: corporate strategy, business-unit strategy and chief-of-staff teams inside one company.
business_type: In-house strategy at a financial-services company

differentiators.text: Headquartered in New York, so corporate strategy roles sit close to senior leadership.
differentiators.significance: In-house strategy in your city, with exposure to how one company makes decisions end to end.

employee_support.text: Careers pages list up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave (birth, adoption, surrogacy); 2017 coverage adds 6-8 extra medical weeks for birth mothers and up to $35,000 for adoption or surrogacy costs.
employee_support.significance: Among the more generous documented leave policies here; confirm current terms.

flexibility.text: 'Amex Flex': depending on role and business needs, colleagues work onsite or hybrid; a third-party site says three office days is typical.
flexibility.significance: Hybrid exists but is set by role; the three-day figure is unconfirmed.

unknowns: A structured early-career strategy program in the US.

sources.title: Benefit News: Amex 20 weeks paid parental leave
